findings.title: Concurrent reader is neither synchronized nor joined before assertions
findings.body: The test starts a reader thread but does not retain or join it. The deletion loop can complete before the reader is ever scheduled, so `deletedAll` is set and the thread exits without issuing any concurrent read; the test then passes without exercising the race it is intended to cover. Conversely, a request already in flight can add an exception after line 157 has asserted the list is empty, leaving an unobserved failure and a thread that can continue into subsequent test cleanup. Coordinate the reader and deleter with latches/barriers and join the thread (preferably in a finally block) before checking captured exceptions.
